import re
import sys

values = {}
for line in sys.stdin:
    match = re.fullmatch(r"\s*(\w+)\s*<-\s*(\w+|\d+)\s*", line)
    if match:
        target, source = match.groups()
        values[target] = values[source] if source.isalpha() else int(source)

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")) + ";")
